item.title: Tell a Friend When to Call
item.prompt_text: Your friend wants to call at four. You are on a bus at four, but you get home at five. Ask your friend to call at five. Say which number to use. Your new number ends in 56.
item.target_grammar: Can't for availability, can for a request, and at for time.
item.fluency_objective: Practise the two times and the last two digits before recording. Check that both times sound different.
item.pronunciation_objective: Give four and five clear stress. Say five six separately at the end.

cues.text: Explain why four is a bad time.

item.model_opening: I can't talk at four because I will be on the bus.
item.model_answer: I can't talk at four because I will be on the bus. I get home at five. Can you call me at five? Use my new number. It ends in five six.
